mechanisms.title: Independent request-scoped resource state
mechanisms.observed: Every add-on resource retains its own request and Loading/Ready/Err; fan-out uses Concurrent effects, only matching loading request receives result; empty/unexpected/transport distinguished.
mechanisms.fotty: Already has StreamDiscoveryCoordinator append-only partial choices and independent failures with18s owner deadline; retain.
mechanisms.next: Keep structured per-provider result/freshness across catalogue→descriptor→native so one publisher failure never controls unrelated availability; explicit retry must refresh relevant bad resource, not silently reuse missing manifest.

mechanisms.title: Capability-driven implementation choice
mechanisms.observed: Selects based on stream shape, transport and platform; unsupported/external stream gets no embedded implementation; returns typed critical unsupported event.
mechanisms.fotty: Native/web engines and StreamSession/StreamPlaybackContract already exist.
mechanisms.next: Make reviewed delivery contract the common input to engine selection and diagnostics; test direct HLS, header-required relay, web-only and unsupported routes on AVPlayer without adding a browser-first dependency.

mechanisms.title: Owned asynchronous load and engine lifetime
mechanisms.observed: Command snapshot cloned/frozen; previous engine destroyed only if implementation class changes; async conversion/probe callbacks compare load identity; live level callback compares HLS instance.
mechanisms.fotty: Current player already uses loadRequestID/source identity; native fullscreen reuses stream.
mechanisms.next: Preserve these owners; add targeted delayed-old-source/cancel/switch regression vectors across new adapters rather than a wholesale player rewrite.

mechanisms.title: Typed terminal errors reach one owner
mechanisms.observed: Maps network, decode, unsupported and conversion failures; ignores nonfatal HLS error at this layer; fatal emits critical and unloads. This layer does not automatically repair dead publishers.
mechanisms.next: Unify adapters into existing failure policy so404/unsupported/network/stall receive appropriate bounded retry/fallback; retain distinction between user-visible recovery and telemetry, no global provider ban for one match.

mechanisms.title: Direct play before optional conversion
mechanisms.observed: Probe checks formats/codecs/channels and uses direct URL when playable; otherwise converts via configured streaming server and guards asynchronous result.
mechanisms.fotty: Direct native/guarded relay already favored over web when qualified.
mechanisms.next: Prefer device-compatible direct native HLS based on decoded-start evidence. Do not adopt a transcoding service or copy VOD retry settings by default on8GB Mac.
